## The two days

| Day | Topics | Slides |
|-----|--------|--------|
| 1 | Setup and help · packages and environments · NumPy · SciPy · scikit-learn | [Day 1](day1.html) |
| 2 | pandas · Matplotlib · seaborn · capstone · where to go next | [Day 2](day2.html) |

Each day runs **3 hours**, with a 10-minute break. Every block starts with a few minutes of slides, then exercises.

## Setup

1. Install [Miniforge](https://conda-forge.org/download/), which gives you `conda` with conda-forge as the default channel.
2. Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/#installing-uv).
3. Get the course materials: `git clone` the course repository, or [download](https://github.com/IgorTatarnikov/course-intro-scientific-python/archive/main.zip) it as a ZIP.
4. In a terminal, from the extracted or cloned course folder:

```bash
conda env create -f environment.yml
conda activate scientific-python
python check_setup.py
```

Every line should say `OK`.

:::: {.columns}

:::
::::

## Where the material comes from

- **Scientific Python Lectures** [@spl]: most NumPy, Matplotlib and SciPy exercises
- **Python Data Science Handbook** [@pdsh]: background reading for NumPy, pandas and plotting
- **Software Carpentry gapminder lesson** [@swc_gapminder]: pandas exercises and the gapminder dataset
